brief.genre: hybrid orchestral sports anthem (stadium broadcast theme meets space epic)
brief.use: main menu loop (alternative to the first menu theme)
brief.game: Fuzeball: 3D table football run by an intergalactic Federation; blue + Federation gold
brief.references: sports broadcast themes, trailer hybrid scores: string ostinato, horn fanfare, taiko-style toms, synth bass pulse, big reverb throws
brief.notes: E minor (contains the UI kit's E F# A B D), Picardy E major at the B climax, no D#. Intro 4 bars once; loop A(8) B(8) C breakdown(8) A'(8) = 32 bars, 60 s. Motif: E-B-B-A / G-A-B in a q. e q q fanfare rhythm, sequenced up a third. Bar 36 and bar 4 both C-D into Em. Wet: Supermassive hall, FlexVerb plate on drums, H-Delay throws. Target -17 LUFS.
